rawContent: Have you noticed that the average suburbanite normie appears to be far less perturbed by the idiot #OPENAMERICANOW protests - that actually put people in danger - than they have been in the past of #BlackLivesMatter demonstrations that block traffic?

But what has really been grinding on me is how these people are disrespecting police in ways I have never seen covering #Occupy or #BlackLivesMatter. Are foul words thrown around? Of course. Does that compare to shouting in the face of a cop during a pandemic? I don't think so.
